title: Country of origin for imported commodities
plain: Imported goods name their country of origin
plain_action: Confirm whether this commodity was imported. A barcode prefix or a foreign-sounding brand does not settle it.

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: imported products carry country of origin, manufacture or assembly as applicable; food may have a distinct origin requirement.

messages.pass: Country of origin is declared for this imported commodity.
messages.violation: This package appears to contain an imported commodity but does not declare the country of origin.

sources.review_status: primary source reviewed; screening paraphrase; incomplete consolidation
